requirements.statement: The existing 14 strict schemas and 64 fixtures remain byte-identical frozen compatibility/evidence assets and are not regenerated; one planned receipt schema is additive future work, not a live 15th asset.
C1 performs generation-independent prepublication verification only; C2 performs postpublication runtime-generation, factory, capability, durable grant-set, and Ready readback only.

Capability truth comes from exact instantiated package-owned factories and current runtime generation: executable rows may be usable, reference rows are configured/reference-only with null adapter identity/generation and unknown evidence, and unconfigured rows are unusable.
Evaluator-owned provider/model/reasoning/fallback/cache, usage, and attempt-visibility classification remains separate from runtime capability evidence and cannot be upgraded by capability metadata.

Required methods are a pure pre-operation function of normalized job/profile planner mode, frozen budgets/features, coherent server grant union, and matching package-owned model.request and method factories.

Feature-implied authority or retired/stale/reference factory state is GRANT_DENIED, current same-generation instantiated-adapter health loss is CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE, and optional unavailable calls fail before send.

After runtime_generation allocation and exact factory projection, aar.runtime.provider_ready_activation.ProviderReadyActivationStore atomically publishes the generation-bound WorkbenchGrantSet at authority/runtime-generations/<20-digit-generation>/workbench-grant-set.json; exact replay is idempotent, conflicting bytes fail, prior-generation session grants are invalid after restart, and session grants are memory-only/current-generation/revocable.
Activation verification and grant construction create no operation, ticket, credential access, physical inference, or provider call.

Sorted-unique grant_ids resolution rejects missing, revoked, expired, mixed-set, mismatched, and duplicate-capability records as frozen-v8 GRANT_DENIED before availability; only valid current same-generation adapter health loss is CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE.

One exact aar.clean-install-preparation.v1 object contains install_epoch, runtime_home_digest, database_identity, database_name, positive backup digest/size, row-set digest, intent_digest, the four-field candidate object, migration_sql_digest, and projected external_authority_store_id, with no staging path.

The authority projection is authority- plus canonical_sha256(authority_material).removeprefix("sha256:"); snapshot_id is empty-v5- plus canonical_sha256(snapshot_material).removeprefix("sha256:"); both obey the strict no-colon token domain.

Issuer, installer, staging verifier, and startup verifier use the same strict canonical target algorithm, canonical JSON UTF-8 bytes, POSIX separators, no normalization/case folding, and exact runtime-home digest object.

Trusted parent and ancestor directory handles retain fstat dev/ino/mode/owner identity; staging is created by dirfd-relative exclusive mode-0700 creation and its fd/dev/ino are retained through publication and the Linux /proc/self/fd SQLite adapter.

All staging, verification, cleanup, and publish operations are fd-relative and no-follow; parent/ancestor replacement and staging substitution refuse with contained evidence rather than deleting by string path.

The planned strict receipt has exactly the frozen fields, candidate equality, positive wheel size, repeated digest equality, sorted unique factory entries, and self receipt_digest described by aar.install-candidate-receipt.v1.

Receipt and wheel inputs are absolute existing regular non-symlink files opened once with retained no-follow descriptors; exact wheel bytes are hashed and ZIP-inspected, and fixed bundled members are byte-bound.

Installer prepublication stops before executable capability/grant/session/runtime-health creation; supervisor after publication allocates/fences runtime_generation=1, instantiates factories, projects capabilities, persists WorkbenchGrantSet, and reads back before Ready.

Startup revalidates receipt and installed member digests plus attestation/profile/inventory without recomputing the deleted backup or overall wheel digest, and performs no schema/profile/install repair.

Old-root acceptance has two atomic alternatives: inactive archive/readback when removal is intended, or proven no-old-root observation on a genuinely fresh host; a nonexistent archive is not required.
The validator enforces exact product_contract fields, atomic row schema, candidate/temporal/identity semantics, frozen-input ordering, semantic self-tests, and status iff failures are empty.

Clean-install preflight requires the supplied self-digested intent to have activation_generation exactly 1 and previous_activation_authority_digest null; any other initial authority fails before staging without rewrite.

After all input and target preflights, the installer issues exactly one install- plus 64 lowercase hexadecimal secrets.token_hex(32) invocation token, freezes it for that invocation, projects it unchanged to preparation install_epoch and attestation cutover_epoch, and never reuses it in a new invocation or adopts its stale stage.

On Linux/WSL the installer-owned SQLiteStageAdapter proves /proc/self/fd/<stage_fd> resolves to the retained stage dev/ino, passes only that root to existing registry/backup/v6 primitives, fences before/after, validates database/backup/WAL/SHM entries no-follow, and fails unsupported before database mutation when the adapter is unavailable.
Frozen v7 capability, v8 tool, registry-v6 DDL, caller-work, operation-event, attempt, lease, dispatch, nullable suspension, successor-outbox, and D1/D2 cell-bound owner bytes remain unchanged.
An untouched legacy root may be observed only for a separately existing v0.5 compatibility claim; it cannot be v0.6 authority, and old/new simultaneous activity fails the release boundary.

The rev2 specification writer changes only the 16 authorized SDD paths; task-start hashes of the three dirty product files and frozen migration-v6 SQL remain unchanged. No reset, clean, stage, commit, push, or product overwrite is part of this specification task.
No paired physical attempt or T5 launcher, machine stop, rerun, score, comparison, winner, or expansion authority exists in this generation.
The strict paired-evaluation-admission document binds exact planning bytes and operator planning authority only; it allocates no physical attempt and no package component consumes it.

The 0.6.0a0 claim is clean-install-only: only an absent target may be published. The product does not preserve v0.5 in place. It does not adopt an old root. It does not downgrade or mutate old-root authority.

runtime.database_identity is db- followed by lowercase hex of canonical_sha256 over schema_version aar.clean-install-database-identity.v1, runtime_home_digest, and database_name reference.sqlite3; inode/dev and staging identity are forbidden.
The installer requires an absolute NUL-free target with an absent final component and rejects every existing target type before mutation with FRESH_INSTALL_TARGET_EXISTS.
The sole public mutation is runtime install with an explicit candidate receipt and wheel; status and activation verification are read-only and no transition mutator is reachable.

One invocation-owned mode-0700 sibling staging directory is created relative to the retained parent handle; all staged database, profile, asset, factory, capability, and grant evidence is verified before publication.
The existing OperationRegistry constructs canonical empty v1-v5 in staging and unchanged migration-v6.sql plus its attestation commit in one SQLite transaction with no schema v7.
The staged v6 database passes complete object inventory, exact attestation, migration SQL digest, integrity/FK, empty-domain, positive backup, and exact clean-preparation projection checks.

Prepublication checks are generation-independent and do not build executable capability rows, WorkbenchGrantSet, session grants, or runtime health; post-publication supervisor startup allocates runtime_generation=1 before projecting capabilities and grant state.
A fully verified staged tree is fsynced and published once with Linux renameat2 RENAME_NOREPLACE; target EEXIST/refusal is not success and no partial target is visible.
Caught failure removes only identity-matched invocation staging; parent/stage drift refuses cleanup and leaves inert evidence, while abrupt residue is never adopted.

Startup verifies immutable install/profile/evidence, then performs only normal runtime-generation and grant writes before Ready; it never initializes, migrates, repairs, adopts, or rewrites install state.

If a legacy root exists and the operator intends removal, an inactive verified external archive/readback is required; on a genuinely fresh host, acceptance requires a proven no-old-root observation, and no nonexistent archive is mandatory.
Candidate admission uses the exact new aar.install-candidate-receipt.v1 contract and absolute wheel/receipt inputs; installed bytes or ambient lookup cannot prove the wheel digest.
The v0.6 constructible publication path is Linux/WSL-only using renameat2 semantics; native Windows fails with FRESH_INSTALL_PUBLICATION_UNSUPPORTED.
T4 live qualification requires exact AAR request-level evidence and honest Prime native/component evidence; requested-only treatment cannot authorize T5.

Clean-install implementation remains standalone and modular: focused install models, installer, activation store, and focused tests own new behavior; admin/operator stay thin, and supervisor/ReferenceHost/MCP receive only the minimum explicit activation injection seam without moving migration or registry ownership.

The selected DIRECT/PLATFORM_PRIMITIVE design produces one usable fresh v6 runtime with one invocation staging owner and Linux renameat2 no-replace publication; it adds no second workbench, broker, provider client, credential store, daemon, database, or recovery ledger.
The public CLI has exactly one install mutation with explicit receipt and wheel, read-only status/verification, and no hidden service control or old-root product mutation.

Every caller-delegated root-planner phase uses one durable model.request ticket with exact kind/phase/step_index, existing v6 request/route/response owners, a unique predecessor event, nullable cell authority, and cell-free successor CAS.
Caller-delegated workbench execution requires frozen start_only=true and rejects start_only=false before operation creation without a duplex exception or frozen schema change.

External planner wait releases the attempt lease and resumes only through exact pending-to-prepared or dead-owner prepared-to-prepared takeover followed by one fenced prepared-to-consumed projection; uncertain outcomes remain reconcile-only.
Only reconciled route, usage, physical-attempt, response-contract, budget, control, deadline, and fence evidence can authorize a planner outcome, and absent usage dimensions remain null.
Recovery begins from a certain pre-cell checkpoint and cannot automatically replay arbitrary Python, a failed source digest, or possibly-sent work.

Settled success/failure/certain cancellation, before-send cancellation, deadline, invalid directive correction, and uncertain caller states map to the frozen one-time consume/no-consume rules with no blind resend.
Specification, implementation, T0-T3 verification, T4 live qualification, and benchmark-planned statuses remain separate and cannot be promoted by inference.

AAR and Prime qualification use one strict component-wise evaluator classification for provider, model, reasoning, fallback, and cache, with requested_only and alias normalization never exceeding native evidence.

Qualification joins exact operation, planner owner, suspension, ticket, physical attempt, request, route, response, timing, adapter-generation, and classification digests and derives route qualification deterministically.
Usage classification distinguishes request_receipt, session_aggregate, partial_events, and unavailable with complete/aggregate/unknown visibility, exact arithmetic, and no zero imputation.

Durable send-start, claim, receipt, retry/recovery, deadline, and reconciliation lineage prevents duplicate or blind replay and never promotes possibly-sent uncertainty to certain success or no-send truth.

Intent, profile, staged tree, database, package assets, receipts, logs, and evaluation evidence contain no credentials or semantic command/endpoint/import fields and never expand or execute identifier contents.
The final exact-wheel release bundle is a non-counted summary assertion that every counted T0-T3 atomic row passes on the exact candidate; it is not an acceptance cell.

The v6 transaction has one atomic fail_after_statement boundary for each of the 25 ordered frozen DDL statements plus explicit pre-first, pre-attestation, pre-schema-migration, pre-commit, and post-commit-readback boundaries.
The temporary empty-v5 backup is positive-size, verified after close/reopen read-only, used through final staged verification, removed before fsync/publication, and never required for startup reread.
